svg.title: An ideal valve responds to a pressure difference
svg.desc: The final 1.5 seconds of the 15-second synthetic fixed-rate run show left ventricular and systemic arterial pressures and forward aortic-valve flow. Flow is zero when ventricular pressure does not exceed arterial pressure. The displayed startup calculation is not asserted to be exactly periodic.
